Report Description///UPDATE TO REPORT #1349387/// THE UPDATE IS AS FOLLOWED: THE CALLER IS CHANGING THE TOTAL AMOUNT THAT DERAILED FROM 1 TO 11. THE CALLER STATES THAT THERE WERE 9 CARS WITH COAL THAT OVERTURNED AND 2 LOCOMOTIVES. THE AMOUNT OF COAL THAT RELEASE IS UNKNOWN, BUT THE AMOUNT OF DIESEL RELEASED WILL BE CHANGED FROM UNKNOWN TO 26 GALLONS. THE CALLER WILL BE UPDATING THE CAR NUMBERS AT A LATER DATE. THE ORIGINAL DESCRIPTION IS AS FOLLOWED: THE CALLER STATED THAT A FREIGHT TRAIN STRUCK A TRACTOR TRAILER TRUCK AT A GRADE CROSSING, WHICH RESULTED IN THE LEAD LOCOMOTIVE DERAILING AND RELEASING AN UNKNOWN AMOUNT OF DIESEL ONTO THE GROUND. ALTHOUGH THE AMOUNT OF MATERIAL THAT RELEASED IS UNKNOWN, THE CALLER STATED IT CONTAINED UPWARDS OF (4000) GALLONS. THE CALLER STATED THAT THE SINGLE MAIN LINE TRACK WAS TAKEN OUT OF SERVICE IN ALL DIRECTIONS, AND THAT THAT IT WAS UNKNOWN IF THE ROAD ASSOCIATED WITH THE INCIDENT HAS BEEN CLOSED. BECAUSE OF THIS INCIDENT THE TRACK INVOLVED DID SUFFER DAMAGES OF AN UNKNOWN PRICE POINT.

Incident Type: FIXED
Material: NATURAL GAS
Medium Affected: OTHER
Suspected Responsible Party:
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 35.728578, -77.933064 (Approximated from street_address)
Report Description
CALLER STATED THERE WAS A STRUCTURE FIRE AT A RESIDENCE AND THE FIRE DEPT WAS CONTACTED AND THEY RESPONDED. THE FIRE DEPARTMENT REQUESTED GAS PERSONNEL ONCE THEY ARRIVED ON SCENE. CALLER STATED THE FIRE DEPT SHUT THE GAS METER OFF. CALLER STATED AFTER THE GAS METER WAS SHUT OFF, THE FIRE DEPT. PERSONNEL SAW A FLASH FROM UNDERNEATH THE HOUSE WHICH IGNITED DUE TO THE HOUSE FIRE. CALLER STATED AN EXPLOSION OCCURRED AFTER THE FLASH. CALLER STATED THE BRAVO BRICK WALL WAS BLOWN OUT FIRST AND FELL ON THE GAS METER WHICH BROKE OFF THE GAS SERVICE RISER. CALLER STATED AFTER THIS, NATURAL GAS IS ESCAPING. AS THE GAS IS ESCAPING THE FIRE DEPT IS TRYING TO PUT THE FIRE OUT AND THE GAS PERSONNEL IS SHUTTING DOWN THE SERVICE KEY TO STOP THE FLOW OF GAS. CALLER STATED THIS WAS ORIGINALLY REPORTED YESTERDAY TO THE NORTH CAROLINA PIPELINE SAFETY SECTION WITHIN THE HOUR.
